job_description: Company Overview :Kenz'up is a dynamic fintech startup launched in June 2020, funded and backed by a major Moroccan corporation. We specialize in financial services and cashback solutions, with our flagship digital cashback application designed to enhance customer retention. Kenz'up aims to support the national financial inclusion strategy and improve the daily lives of millions of Moroccans through a wide range of financial services.Position Overview :We are looking for a versatile, tech-oriented profile. The Partner Tech Support Manager will support Kenz’up’s partners throughout the deployment, go-live, and maintenance phases of the Kenz’up service within their organizations.As the primary point of contact, this role is key in resolving technical issues related to the integration of Kenz’up into partner ecosystems. Acting as Lever 1 technical support, the Partner Tech Support Manager is responsible for conducting initial diagnostics when bugs are reported by partners. The role also involves supporting the deployment of new points of sale and onboarding new partners. In short, the Partner Tech Support Manager is the trusted technical contact for all partner-related issues with Kenz’up.Your Role :Support the launch of new points of sale and partners by managing all required configurationsDiagnose, resolve when possible, or escalate partner-reported technical issues to the appropriate internal (Kenz’up) or partner stakeholdersAct as the technical point of contact for partners: incident resolution, follow-up, and proactive communicationEnsure rigorous tracking of reported bugs and maintain regular communication with partners.Required technical experience :Strong knowledge of debugging concepts, log analysis, testing, and production rolloutsUnderstanding of the fundamentals of production technical environmentsExcellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and FrenchPrevious experience as an operator of production environments in nearshoring structures for large international accounts is a strong assetKnowledge of Python and SQL is a plusCuriosity and eagerness to learn new technologies are essentialPowered by JazzHRQvWwaAkMUB
